covered: Same verification modal remains active after identity heading becomes SMS step
View screenshot, user input and final proof share the modal tracker
Unknown/replacement verification root stays latched and clears frames
Known background DOM identity cannot excuse a replacement modal containing QR
Original QR dataPNG is relayed without element screenshot; SMS occlusion clears QR
Original input page is navigated once only; self-proof uses a separate same-context page
Late response body from original page cannot serve as fresh probe proof
Probe page requiring MFA returns a fixed failure rather than waiting invisibly or declaring success
450ms about:blank probe navigation waits, then new official profile proof can succeed
Probe timeout, connection failure and final blank are fixed timeout/runtime, never MFA or authentication success
Temporary probe DOM exception can recover; persistent unknown DOM cannot save authentication
Source page owner and the actual gate epoch are bound before new proof requests
boundaries: Existing browser runtime fixture uses explicit Mock transport; it is not a real Douyin login or capture
No real SMS, model or Feishu call; no user browser or saved state was inspected
Actual official authentication and persistence require separate live validation
A new MFA challenge on the proof-only page is not adopted; current attempt exits with douyin_session_verification_required
Unidentifiable or replaced verification modal remains conservatively incomplete
A retained transparent/unknown verification root may conservatively prevent the proof gate; no broader heuristic was introduced
No real user QR scan, phone approval, SMS, authentication persistence or customer Windows proof is established by this contract report
